content.comment_body: I'm attending a college where [product_name] version [version_no] is used on Windows 7. I can't get it to run on my own computer because of compatibility problems. My question is: If I install [product_name] version [version_no] and create save files at home, can I edit and view them at school, where they use [version_no]?

Hello, If you want to use [product_name] version [version_no], you also need [product_name] [version_no]. With [product_name] [version_no], you can't transfer programs between [product_name] [version_no] and [product_name] [version_no]. This doesn't depend on the operating system. To update: Copy the [product_name] [version_no] CD to your Windows 7 PC. Go to the folder Voll\CD-ROM\Windows\Tools\Application and run [product_name].exe. In [product_name], go to Help/Update Center and upgrade to [version_no]. Hope this is helpful.

analysis.insight_summary: Users experience difficulties with compatibility between different versions of [product_name] when sharing files between personal and school computers. The key usability issue is that files made in one version can't be easily opened or edited in another, disrupting workflow and learning for students who need to use projects across different environments.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect project files to work smoothly across various versions of [product_name] on different computers, allowing easy editing and viewing regardless of the version in use.
